blogs.title: Look Past the Triad: The Adult Presentation of Telomere Biology Disorders
blogs.description: This post explores the shifting paradigm of Dyskeratosis Congenita (DC) as a childhood syndrome to an adult survival syndrome. It discusses the clinical pitfalls of relying on the classic mucocutaneous triad and emphasizes the utility of registry-medicine when young adults present with unexplained multisystem premature ageing. We analyze how TBDs can mimic acquired conditions like autoimmune disease or drug toxicity and why telomere length testing is crucial in high-suspicion cases.

blogs.title: Nutritional Deficiencies as Clues, Not Culprits: The B12 Excuse for Dyskeratosis Congenita
blogs.description: A deep dive into the diagnostic tension between severe acquired vitamin B12 deficiency and inherent bone marrow failure syndromes. Using this case, we illustrate how correcting nutritional deficiencies may not resolve underlying hematologic instability derived from telomere shortening. The post dissects the specific laboratory findings (dimorphic smear, basophilic stippling) and the logistical challenge of distinguishing malabsorption from progressive marrow failure.

blogs.title: The Hepatopulmonary Fibrosis Nexus: Keeping Your Finger on the Telomere Pulse
blogs.description: This post covers the emerging clinical association between Telomere Biology Disorders (TBD) and organ fibrosis, specifically cirrhosis and idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) in young adults. We discuss the diagnostic urgency of unexplained lung fibrosis or elevated liver stiffness (FEIST/S3) in a patient <40 years old, arguing for genetic sequencing over invasive autoimmune/liver biopsy workups first.

blogs.title: When the Variant is 'Unknown': Integrating Phenotype to Interpret Genetic Variants of Uncertain Significance
blogs.description: Focusing on the complexities of genomic interpretation, this post analyzes the PARN variant identified in this case and its initial classification as a Variant of Uncertain Significance (VUS). It provides a practical framework for clinicians on how strong clinical phenotyping can drive the pathogenicity of a genetic finding, discussing ACMG criteria and the role of haploinsufficiency in rare disease genetics.

blogs.title: Beyond Supportive Care: The Role of Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplant in TBD
blogs.description: This post discusses the management landscape for Telomere Biology Disorders, focusing on the timing and indications for Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation (HSCT). It weighs the risks of procuring grafts in patients with shortened telomeres against the benefits of curative potential, and outlines a strategic approach to surveillance for organ decline versus proactive intervention in progressive marrow failure.
